title: Catalan Sofrito

items: ½ bell pepper, seeded and minced
1 lbs tomatoes (10 plum or 1-28oz cans of whole tomatoes)

steps: Heat the oil and gently cook the onions until translucent but not browned, approximately 8-10 minutes.
Add the garlic, bell pepper, and cook until these soften and fall apart a bit.
Stir in the tomatoes, bay leaf, and salt. Simmer gently, over very low heat for 50 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Remove the bay leaf, allow to cool, and store in the refrigerator.
reviewFlags: Paprika is listed among the ingredients, but the source does not say when to add it.
sourceNote: Adapted from Bulla Gastrobar Restaurante, Legacy West, Plano, TX
